Tally releases

Source: R/summary.R
dig_tally.Rd

Counts the rows of a tibble returned by tidycrates, such as the copies in a collection or the releases of a label, by genre, style, format, label, artist, role, country, year, decade or month added. Only the columns of x are used, so no requests are sent.

Usage

dig_tally(
  x,
  by = c("genre", "style", "format", "label", "artist", "role", "country", "decade",
    "year", "added"),
  n = 10,
  unique = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A tibble returned by one of the functions listed in Details.

by

What to count by: "genre", "style", "format", "label", "artist", "role", "country", "decade", "year" or "added", the month a copy was added.

n

The number of values to keep for all but years, decades and months. The rest are counted together as "Other". Inf keeps all values.

unique

If TRUE, each release counts once, however many copies of it there are.

Value

A tibble with a column named after by, n, the number of rows, and share, the share of all rows. For by = "added", total gives the running number of rows at the end of each month, such as the size of a collection. Years, decades and months are in order, and other values are sorted from most to least common. "Other" counts the rows with at least one value outside the top n. It is called "All other" if one of the values is "Other". NULL is returned invisibly if x is NULL.

Details

Which values of by work depends on where x comes from:

x fromby
dig_collection(), dig_wantlist()genre, style, format, label, artist, decade, year, added
dig_release()genre, style, format, label, artist, country, decade, year, added
dig_master()genre, style, artist, decade, year
dig_artist_releases()format, label, artist, role, decade, year
dig_label_releases()format, artist, decade, year
dig_master_versions()format, label, country, decade, year
dig_search()genre, style, format, label, country, decade, year

A row with several genres, styles, formats or labels counts once for each of them, so the shares can add up to more than 1. Rows without a value, such as releases with an unknown year, are left out.

The lists of dig_artist_releases() and dig_label_releases() give formats as descriptions such as 2x12", Comp. Only the first part is counted, without the number of items, so vinyl is counted by size, for example 12". dig_search() gives the format of a release followed by its descriptions, and only the format is counted. Master releases in dig_artist_releases() stand for all their versions and have no format or label. For dig_release(), added is the month the release was added to 'Discogs'.

Collections and wantlists have no country, because 'Discogs' does not return it for them. To tally a collection by country, get its releases first with dig_release(collection$release_id). This sends one request for each release.

Tallies of a collection or wantlist are still Restricted Data, see dig_collection().

Examples

shelf <- tibble::tibble(
  release_id = c(1, 1, 2, 3),
  year = c(1994, 1994, 1998, NA),
  genres = list(c("Electronic", "Pop"), c("Electronic", "Pop"), "Electronic", "Jazz")
)
dig_tally(shelf, "genre")
#> # A tibble: 3 × 3
#>   genre          n share
#>   <chr>      <int> <dbl>
#> 1 Electronic     3  0.75
#> 2 Pop            2  0.5 
#> 3 Jazz           1  0.25
dig_tally(shelf, "decade")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   decade     n share
#>    <dbl> <int> <dbl>
#> 1   1990     3  0.75
dig_tally(shelf, "genre", unique = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 3
#>   genre          n share
#>   <chr>      <int> <dbl>
#> 1 Electronic     2 0.667
#> 2 Jazz           1 0.333
#> 3 Pop            1 0.333

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
collection <- dig_collection("username", all = TRUE)
dig_tally(collection, "genre")
dig_tally(collection, "added")
dig_tally(dig_label_releases(1, all = TRUE), "decade")
}
